sys_cs_topic.description: Help students view their active campus asset rentals. Students can ask to see the assets they currently have rented, rental ID, asset name, rental status, checkout date, due date, and renewal information. This topic handles questions such as "Show my rentals", "What assets am I currently using?", "When is my laptop due?", and "What is the status of my rental?"
